paragraphs.text: Coral reefs damaged by storms and warming seas can take decades to recover naturally. To speed this up, marine biologists in several countries are growing corals in underwater nurseries.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Small fragments are cut from healthy corals and attached to frames shaped like trees, which hang in the water a few metres below the surface. Here the fragments receive plenty of light and are kept away from the sea floor, where sand can bury them.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: After six to twelve months, the fragments have grown large enough to be moved. Divers attach them to damaged parts of the reef using a special underwater glue or small metal nails.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Scientists try to use corals that survived recent heatwaves, in the hope that these will cope better with future rises in temperature.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Volunteers from local diving clubs often help with this work, and some projects allow tourists to join a dive to see the nurseries for themselves.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: can take decades to recover naturally

explanation.en: Without help reefs “can take decades to recover naturally”. “Without help” means “naturally”, so the answer is decades.
explanation.kk: Көмексіз рифтер «can take decades to recover naturally». Түйіндегі «without help» — «naturally» дегені, жауап decades.
explanation.ru: Без помощи рифы «can take decades to recover naturally». «Without help» в пересказе значит «naturally», ответ decades.

items.quote: attached to frames shaped like trees

explanation.en: “frames shaped like trees” → trees, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: «frames shaped like trees» → trees, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «frames shaped like trees» → trees, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

items.quote: kept away from the sea floor, where sand can bury them
items.prompt: safe from 3 ____ on the sea floor

explanation.en: On the sea floor “sand can bury them” → sand. “Light” is what they receive, not what they avoid.
explanation.kk: Түбінде үзінділерді құм басып қалуы мүмкін: «where sand can bury them» → sand. «Light» — олар, керісінше, алатын нәрсе.
explanation.ru: На дне фрагменты может засыпать песок: «where sand can bury them» → sand. «Light» — то, что они, наоборот, получают.

items.quote: using a special underwater glue or small metal nails

explanation.en: “special underwater glue or small metal nails” → metal nails (“nails” is also accepted). “Small metal nails” is three words.
explanation.kk: «special underwater glue or small metal nails» → metal nails (nails да есептеледі). «Small metal nails» — үш сөз, шектен асады.
explanation.ru: «special underwater glue or small metal nails» → metal nails (засчитывается и nails). «Small metal nails» — три слова, больше лимита.

items.quote: Scientists try to use corals that survived recent heatwaves

explanation.en: “corals that survived recent heatwaves” → recent heatwaves (“heatwaves” is also accepted). “Prefer” paraphrases “try to use”.
explanation.kk: «corals that survived recent heatwaves» → recent heatwaves (heatwaves да есептеледі). «Prefer» — «try to use» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы.
explanation.ru: «corals that survived recent heatwaves» → recent heatwaves (засчитывается и heatwaves). «Prefer» пересказывает «try to use».
